plugin.description:
All-in-one quality-of-life suite for Eureka (Anemos, Pagos, Pyros, Hydatos). Features lethal aggro radar visualizers (sleeping dragon sound aggro, low HP blood aggro, sprite magic aggro, vision cones, combat cast alerts), real-time ffxiv-eureka.com Phoenix WebSocket tracker synchronization, bunny FATE timer and coffer markers, and Logos & Loot errands. Bunny FATE automation is unlocked by a privately granted access package.
https://aethertek.io/x.json
